ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.BotNavi:
local Pathfinding=game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Config=require(script.Parent.BotProfiles).Budget
local Navigation={} Navigation.__index=Navigation
local queue={} local busy=0 local tokens=Config.PathsPerSecond local stamp=os.clock()
Navigation.Metrics={computations=0,failures=0,stuck=0,recoveries=0,abandoned=0,maxConcurrent=0}
function Navigation.Pump(now)
 tokens=math.min(Config.PathsPerSecond,tokens+(now-stamp)*Config.PathsPerSecond) stamp=now
 while busy<Config.ConcurrentPaths and tokens>=1 and #queue>0 do
  local job=table.remove(queue,1) local self=job.nav
  if self.alive and job.generation==self.generation then
   busy+=1 tokens-=1 Navigation.Metrics.computations+=1 Navigation.Metrics.maxConcurrent=math.max(busy,Navigation.Metrics.maxConcurrent)
   task.spawn(function()
    local path=Pathfinding:CreatePath({AgentRadius=2.1,AgentHeight=5.5,AgentCanJump=true,AgentCanClimb=true,WaypointSpacing=4,Costs={Water=25}})
    local ok=pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(self.root.Position,job.goal) end)
    busy-=1
    if not self.alive or job.generation~=self.generation then path:Destroy() return end
    self.pending=false
    if ok and path.Status==Enum.PathStatus.Success then
     self:_clearRoute() self.route=path self.waypoints=path:GetWaypoints() self.index=2 self.failures=0 self.plannedAt=os.clock()
     self.blocked=path.Blocked:Connect(function(index) if self.alive and job.generation==self.generation and index>=self.index then self.replan=true self.reason="blocked" end end)
     if Run:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute("BotDiagnosticsEnabled") then
      local debugFolder=Instance.new("Folder") debugFolder.Name="BotRoute" debugFolder.Parent=self.bot self.debugFolder=debugFolder
      for i=2,math.min(#self.waypoints,24) do
       local a,b=self.waypoints[i-1].Position,self.waypoints[i].Position local delta=b-a
       if delta.Magnitude>.1 then local p=Instance.new("Part") p.Name="Waypoint" p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.Size=Vector3.new(.07,.07,delta.Magnitude) p.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((a+b)*.5,b) p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,90) p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon p.Parent=debugFolder end
      end
     end
    else
     path:Destroy() self.failures+=1 Navigation.Metrics.failures+=1 self.nextPlan=os.clock()+math.min(5,self.failures*1.2)
     self.reason="no_path" self:_clearRoute()
     if self.failures>=3 then self:Abandon(os.clock()) end
    end
   end)
  end
 end
end
function Navigation.new(bot)
 local self=setmetatable({bot=bot,root=bot.HumanoidRootPart,humanoid=bot.Humanoid,alive=true,generation=0,index=2,failures=0,nextPlan=0,plannedAt=0,lastMove=0,lastProgress=os.clock(),travel=0,recovery=0},Navigation)
 self.position=self.root.Position self.progressPosition=self.root.Position self.updatedAt=os.clock() self.idleSeconds=0 self.stuckCount=0 return self
end
function Navigation:_clearRoute()
 if self.blocked then self.blocked:Disconnect() self.blocked=nil end
 if self.route then self.route:Destroy() self.route=nil end
 if self.debugFolder then self.debugFolder:Destroy() self.debugFolder=nil end self.waypoints=nil self.command=nil
end
function Navigation:Clear(from,to)
 local delta=to-from
 if delta.Magnitude>18 or math.abs(delta.Y)>4 then return false end
 local params=RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances={self.bot} params.RespectCanCollide=true
 local hit=delta.Magnitude>.1 and workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from+Vector3.new(0,.4,0)),Vector3.new(3.2,3.5,3.2),delta,params)
 local ground=workspace:Raycast(to+Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-10,0),params)
 return not hit and ground~=nil
end
function Navigation:SetGoal(goal,now)
 if self.failedGoal and now<(self.failedUntil or 0) and (goal-self.failedGoal).Magnitude<12 then return false end
 if not self.goal or (self.goal-goal).Magnitude>10 then
  self.goal=goal self.generation+=1 self.pending=false self.replan=true self.nextPlan=math.max(now,self.nextPlan) self.reason="goal_changed"
  self:_clearRoute() self.lastProgress=now self.position=self.root.Position self.recovery=0
 end
 return true
end
function Navigation:Abandon(now)
 self.failedGoal=self.goal self.failedUntil=now+7 self.goal=nil self.generation+=1 self.pending=false self:_clearRoute()
 self.humanoid:MoveTo(self.root.Position) self.reason="abandoned" self.recovery=0 Navigation.Metrics.abandoned+=1
end
function Navigation:Pause()
 self.goal=nil self.generation+=1 self.pending=false self:_clearRoute() self.humanoid:MoveTo(self.root.Position)
end
function Navigation.ReachedWaypoint(position,waypoint)
 local delta=position-waypoint
 -- Path waypoints are on the navmesh floor; HumanoidRootPart is above it.
 return Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude<2.8 and math.abs(delta.Y)<6
end
function Navigation:Update(now)
 if not self.goal or not self.alive then return end
 local root,h=self.root,self.humanoid local distance=(root.Position-self.goal).Magnitude
 local progress=(root.Position-self.position).Magnitude self.travel+=progress self.position=root.Position
 local step=math.min(.5,now-self.updatedAt) self.updatedAt=now
 if progress<.1 then self.idleSeconds+=math.max(0,step) end
 if distance<3.5 then self.lastProgress=now self.recovery=0 h:Move(Vector3.zero) self.command=nil return end
 if (root.Position-self.progressPosition).Magnitude>1.2 then self.lastProgress=now self.recovery=0 self.progressPosition=root.Position end
 if now-self.lastProgress>2.5 then
  self.recovery+=1 self.stuckCount+=1 self.lastProgress=now Navigation.Metrics.stuck+=1 self.reason="recover_"..self.recovery
  if self.recovery==1 then
   local delta=self.goal-root.Position local side=Vector3.new(-delta.Z,0,delta.X)
   if side.Magnitude>.1 then local point=root.Position+side.Unit*3 if self:Clear(root.Position,point) then h:MoveTo(point) self.localUntil=now+.5 Navigation.Metrics.recoveries+=1 end end
  elseif self.recovery==2 then self.localUntil=now+.45 h:Move(Vector3.zero)
  elseif self.recovery<5 then self.replan=true self.nextPlan=now self:_clearRoute()
  else self:Abandon(now) return end
 end
 if now<(self.localUntil or 0) then return end
 if now>=(self.nextProbe or 0) then self.direct=self:Clear(root.Position,self.goal) self.nextProbe=now+.4 end
 if not self.direct and not self.pending and now>=self.nextPlan and (not self.waypoints or self.replan or now-self.plannedAt>6) then
  self.pending=true self.replan=false self.nextPlan=now+1.5 table.insert(queue,{nav=self,generation=self.generation,goal=self.goal})
 end
 local waypoint=self.waypoints and self.waypoints[self.index]
 if waypoint and Navigation.ReachedWaypoint(root.Position,waypoint.Position) then
  if waypoint.Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then h.Jump=true end
  self.index+=1 waypoint=self.waypoints[self.index]
 end
 local destination=self.direct and self.goal or waypoint and waypoint.Position
 if not destination then h:Move(Vector3.zero) self.command=nil return end
 if waypoint and not self.direct and waypoint.Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then h.Jump=true end
 if not self.command or (destination-self.command).Magnitude>1 or now-self.lastMove>2 then h:MoveTo(destination) self.command=destination self.lastMove=now end
end
function Navigation:Destroy()
 if not self.alive then return end self.alive=false self.generation+=1 self:_clearRoute()
 for i=#queue,1,-1 do if queue[i].nav==self then table.remove(queue,i) end end
end
function Navigation.Stats() local copy=table.clone(Navigation.Metrics) copy.queued=#queue copy.concurrent=busy return copy end
return Navigation
ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.CTFBotO:
local Damage=require(game.ServerScriptService.MainGameScript.GameManager.DamageService)
local Adapter={} Adapter.__index=Adapter
local lanes={-1,1,0,-1,1,0}
local function spacing()
 local arena=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure")
 return arena and arena:GetAttribute("LaneSpacing") or 70
end
function Adapter.new(bot,team,slot,flags) return setmetatable({bot=bot,team=team,slot=slot,flags=flags,lane=(lanes[slot] or 0)*spacing()},Adapter) end
function Adapter.Cross(position,target,lane)
 local arena=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure")
 local routes=arena and arena:FindFirstChild("BotRoutes")
 if routes then
  if math.abs(position.X-target.X)>80 then
  local route=routes:FindFirstChild(lane<0 and "North" or lane>0 and "South" or "Center")
  if route then
   local points=route:GetChildren() local direction=target.X>position.X and 1 or -1
   table.sort(points,function(a,b)return a.Position.X*direction<b.Position.X*direction end)
   for _,point in points do
    if (point.Position.X-position.X)*direction>12 and (target.X-point.Position.X)*direction>12 then return point.Position end
   end
  end
  end
  return target
 end
 if position.X<-36 and target.X>36 then return Vector3.new(-32,41,lane) end
 if position.X>36 and target.X<-36 then return Vector3.new(32,41,lane) end
 if position.X<36 and position.X>=-36 and target.X>36 then return Vector3.new(42,41,lane) end
 if position.X>-36 and position.X<=36 and target.X<-36 then return Vector3.new(-42,41,lane) end
 return target
end
function Adapter:Candidates()
 local result={}
 for _,player in game.Players:GetPlayers() do if player:GetAttribute("InArena") and player.Team~=self.team and player.Character then table.insert(result,player.Character) end end
 local bots=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFBots")
 if bots then for _,bot in bots:GetChildren() do local team=bot:GetAttribute("CTFTeam") if bot~=self.bot and typeof(team)=="string" and team~=self.team.Name then table.insert(result,bot) end end end
 return result
end
function Adapter:Objective(memory,now)
 local own=self.flags:GetFlag(self.team.Name) local other=self.flags:GetFlag(self.team.Name=="Blue" and "Red" or "Blue")
 if not own or not other then return end
 local root=self.bot.HumanoidRootPart local sign=self.team.Name=="Blue" and -1 or 1
 local position,label,critical
 if other.carrier==self.bot then position=own.home label="Returning" critical=true
 elseif own.state=="dropped" then position=own.hitbox.Position label="Recovering" critical=true
 elseif own.carrier and memory.target==own.carrier and memory.position then position=memory.position label="Intercepting"
 elseif other.carrier and other.carrier~=self.bot and Damage:Team(other.carrier)==self.team then
  local r=other.carrier:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if r then position=r.Position+Vector3.new(-sign*10,0,self.slot%2==0 and 7 or -7) label="Escorting" end
 elseif self.bot:GetAttribute("CTFRole")=="Guardian" then
  position=own.home+Vector3.new(-sign*22,0,self.lane*.45) label="Guarding"
 else position=other.hitbox.Position label="Capturing" end
 if not position then position=own.home label="Guarding" end
 if label=="Guarding" then position+=Vector3.new(math.sin(now*.22+self.slot)*6,0,math.cos(now*.22+self.slot)*7) end
 return {position=Adapter.Cross(root.Position,position,self.lane),label=label,critical=critical}
end
function Adapter:Cover(threat)
 local infrastructure=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure") local covers=infrastructure and infrastructure:FindFirstChild("TacticalCover")
 if not covers or not threat then return end
 local root=self.bot.HumanoidRootPart local best,score
 local params=RaycastParams.new() params.FilterDescendantsInstances={self.bot} params.RespectCanCollide=true
 for _,model in covers:GetChildren() do
  local node=model:FindFirstChild("CoverNode")
  if node then
   local distance=(node.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
   if distance<55 then
    local delta=node.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.3,0)-threat local result=workspace:Raycast(threat,delta,params)
    if result and (result.Position-node.Position).Magnitude>2 then
     local value=distance+(model:GetAttribute("CoverTeam")==self.team.Name and 0 or 12)
     if not score or value<score then score=value best=node.Position end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
function Adapter:Alternate()
 self.lane=self.lane==0 and (self.slot%2==0 and spacing() or -spacing()) or 0
 local own=self.flags:GetFlag(self.team.Name)
 return own and own.home+Vector3.new(self.team.Name=="Blue" and 16 or -16,0,self.lane*.4)
end
return Adapter
StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Weapo:
-- Evaluate every visible R15 wielder locally, after animation evaluation.
local Pose=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Crossgrounds"):WaitForChild("ArmPose"))
local Carry=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponLocomotion)
local Action=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponActionMotion)
local AX50=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.AX50Motion)
local Stats=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponStats)
local Reload=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponReloadMotion)
local Hold=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponHold)
local Locomotion=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.LocomotionMotion)
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Preferences=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.MotionPreferences)
local viewer=Players.LocalPlayer
local active={} local pending={} local necks={} local gait=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(v) necks[v]=nil end)
local function register(tool)
 if active[tool] or pending[tool] or not tool:GetAttribute("TwoHanded") then return end
 pending[tool]=true
 task.delay(.12,function()
  pending[tool]=nil local c=tool.Parent local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") if not h or not handle or h.RigType~=Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return end
  local left=Pose.Chain(c,"Left") local right=handle:FindFirstChild("RightHandGrip") and Pose.Chain(c,"Right") or nil
  active[tool]={character=c,humanoid=h,carry=Carry.new(),equippedAt=os.clock(),locomotion=Locomotion.new(),kick=0,reloadMotion=Reload.new(),player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(c),left=left,right=right,support=handle:FindFirstChild("SupportGrip"),grip=handle:FindFirstChild("RightHandGrip")}
 end)
end
local function added(value)
 if value:IsA("Tool") then register(value)
 elseif value:IsA("JointInstance") and value.Name=="CrossgroundsWeaponMount" and value.Part1 then
  local t=value.Part1.Parent if t and t:IsA("Tool") then register(t) end
 end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(added)
for _,value in workspace:GetDescendants() do added(value) end
Run.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
 local bots=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFBots")
 if bots then for _,bot in bots:GetChildren() do
  local simple=Preferences.CharacterWeight(viewer)
  local neck=necks[bot] if not neck or not neck.Parent then neck=bot:FindFirstChild("Neck",true) necks[bot]=neck end
  if neck and neck:IsA("Motor6D") then
   local phase=os.clock()*.7+(bot:GetAttribute("BotScanSeed") or 0)
   local alert=bot:GetAttribute("BotAlert")
   neck.Transform=Preferences.Transform(CFrame.Angles(math.sin(phase*1.8)*.025,alert and 0 or math.sin(phase)*.18,math.sin(phase*.6)*.025),simple)
  end
  local h=bot:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local root=bot:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if h and h.Health>0 and root then
   local speed=Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,0,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude
   local g=gait[bot]
   if not g or os.clock()>(g.refreshAt or 0) then
    g=g or {phase=0} g.refreshAt=os.clock()+2
    for _,name in {"LeftHip","RightHip","LeftKnee","RightKnee","LeftAnkle","RightAnkle","Waist"} do g[name]=bot:FindFirstChild(name,true) end
    gait[bot]=g
   end
   local weight=h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air and math.clamp(speed/16,0,1) or 0
   g.phase+=dt*math.clamp(speed*.7,0,14)
   for _,side in {"Left","Right"} do
    local swing=math.sin(g.phase+(side=="Left" and 0 or math.pi))*weight*simple
    local hip=g[side.."Hip"] local knee=g[side.."Knee"] local ankle=g[side.."Ankle"]
    if hip then hip.Transform=CFrame.Angles(swing*.55,0,0) end
    if knee then knee.Transform=CFrame.Angles(math.max(0,-swing)*.85,0,0) end
    if ankle then ankle.Transform=CFrame.Angles(-swing*.20,0,0) end
   end
   if g.Waist then g.Waist.Transform=Preferences.Transform(CFrame.new(0,math.sin(g.phase*2)*.025*weight,0)*CFrame.Angles(weight*.07,math.sin(g.phase)*.035*weight,0),simple) end
  end
 end end
 for tool,r in active do
  if tool.Parent~=r.character or not r.character.Parent or r.humanoid.Health<=0 then if r.mount and r.mount.Parent then r.mount.Transform=CFrame.new() end active[tool]=nil
  elseif tool:GetAttribute("SupportGripActive") then
   -- Avatar descriptions can replace limbs/joints after equipping.
   if not r.refreshAt or os.clock()>=r.refreshAt then
    r.left=Pose.Chain(r.character,"Left") r.right=r.grip and Pose.Chain(r.character,"Right") or nil r.refreshAt=os.clock()+.5
   end
   local torso=r.character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") local root=r.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local mount=torso and torso:FindFirstChild("CrossgroundsWeaponMount") r.mount=mount
   local desired local reload local bolt
   if mount and mount.Part1==tool.Handle and root then
    local velocity=root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
    local amount=r.player and r.player:GetAttribute("SettingCameraMotion") if amount==nil then amount=.35 end
    local running=r.player and r.player:GetAttribute("SprintActive")==true
    local aiming=r.player and r.player:GetAttribute("CombatAiming")==true
    local firing=r.player and r.player:GetAttribute("CombatFiring")==true
    local visualWeight=Preferences.WeaponWeight(viewer)
    local pose=r.carry:Update(dt,velocity,r.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air,running,aiming,firing or tool:GetAttribute("Reloading") or tool:GetAttribute("Attacking"),amount)

    local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local duration=math.max(.1,tool:GetAttribute("ReloadDuration") or 1)
    local t=tool:GetAttribute("Reloading") and math.clamp((now-(tool:GetAttribute("ReloadStartedAt") or now))/duration,0,1) or 0
    reload=r.reloadMotion:Update(tool,dt,now)
    if Hold.IsPistol(tool) then
     if not r.reloadParts then r.reloadParts={} for _,part in tool:GetChildren() do if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("ReloadGroup") then for _,joint in part:GetChildren() do if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then table.insert(r.reloadParts,{part=part,joint=joint,group=part:GetAttribute("ReloadGroup"),only=part:GetAttribute("ReloadOnly")}) end end end end end
     for _,entry in r.reloadParts do if entry.joint.Parent then
      local pivot=tool.Handle:FindFirstChild("ReloadPivot_"..entry.group)
      local transform=Preferences.Transform(Reload.PartTransform(reload,entry.group,pivot and pivot.Position),visualWeight)
      entry.joint.Transform=entry.joint.C0:Inverse()*transform*entry.joint.C0
      entry.part.LocalTransparencyModifier=(reload.visibility and reload.visibility[entry.group] or 0)*visualWeight
      if entry.only then entry.part.Transparency=reload.active>.02 and visualWeight>.01 and 0 or 1 end
     end end
    end
    local loco=r.locomotion:Update(dt,velocity,r.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air,r.character:GetAttribute("SlideActive")==true)
    local action=Action.Sample({equippedFor=os.clock()-r.equippedAt,slide=loco.slide,land=loco.land})
    local shot=tool:GetAttribute("PresentationShotAt") or -100
    if tool:GetAttribute('WeaponId')=='ax_50' then
     local data=Stats.ResolveTool(tool)
     bolt=AX50.Bolt(now-shot,data and data.Cooldown,tool:GetAttribute('Reloading'))
     if not r.bolts then
      r.bolts={}
      for _,p in tool:GetChildren() do if p:IsA('BasePart') and p.Name=='Bolt' then
       for _,joint in p:GetChildren() do if joint:IsA('Motor6D') then table.insert(r.bolts,joint) end end
      end end
     end
     for _,joint in r.bolts do if joint.Parent then
      local pivot=Vector3.new(0,joint.C0.Y,joint.C0.Z)
      local delta=CFrame.new(pivot)*Preferences.Transform(bolt.bolt,visualWeight)*CFrame.new(-pivot)
      joint.Transform=joint.C0:Inverse()*delta*joint.C0
     end end
     action.weapon*=bolt.weapon
    end
    local kick=math.exp(-math.max(0,now-shot)*22)
    local pitch=r.character:GetAttribute("CombatAimPitch") or 0
    pose=CFrame.Angles(math.clamp(pitch,-1.15,1.15)*.8,0,0)*pose*action.weapon*reload.weapon*CFrame.new(0,0,kick*.10)*CFrame.Angles(kick*.04,0,0)
    pose=CFrame.Angles(math.clamp(pitch,-1.15,1.15)*.8,0,0)*Preferences.Transform(CFrame.Angles(-math.clamp(pitch,-1.15,1.15)*.8,0,0)*pose,visualWeight)
    mount.Transform=pose desired=torso.CFrame*mount.C0*pose*mount.C1:Inverse()
   end
   if r.right and r.grip and r.grip.Parent then Pose.Solve(r.right,r.grip,desired and desired*CFrame.new(bolt and bolt.hand*Preferences.WeaponWeight(viewer) or Vector3.zero)*r.grip.CFrame) end
   local leftAttachment = r.support
if not leftAttachment or not leftAttachment.Parent then
    -- fallback to muzzle if no support grip
    leftAttachment = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
end
if r.left and leftAttachment and leftAttachment.Parent then
    Pose.Solve(r.left, leftAttachment, desired and desired*CFrame.new(reload and reload.hand*Preferences.WeaponWeight(viewer) or Vector3.zero)*leftAttachment.CFrame*Preferences.Transform(reload and reload.handRotation or CFrame.identity,Preferences.WeaponWeight(viewer)))
end
  end
 end
end)
